g.text: Fullstack Developer · C# · ASP.NET · React · Lisboa
Fullstack developer based in Lisbon. I work mostly in C# and ASP.NET on the backend and React on the frontend, and I'm
currently studying software development at ISTEC.
Before that I did a 600-hour remote internship at CINEL, building a web management app in ASP.NET and a REST API with
a React client on top of it. I also spent a year at Number Seven reviewing C# and C++ projects submitted by students.
Reading a couple hundred codebases written by other people taught me more about naming things and structuring a
Live tracking for Carris Metropolitana buses. Built because I was tired of standing at a stop with no idea whether the bus
was two minutes away or had already gone. It reads the official API and caches responses through Redis, so upstream isn't
hit on every map pan. Installable as a PWA, since the whole point is using it at the stop.
A cooking site with recipes from ten countries, a Gemini chatbot, and a challenge system with four difficulty levels. This
was my final secondary school project. The part I'd point at is the fallback layer, a local response path that keeps the chat
Where the rest of the work lives, with screenshots and short write-ups of what each project does.
Open to junior positions and internships — Lisbon, hybrid or remote.
